@triton.jit
def awq_gemm_kernel(a_ptr, b_ptr, c_ptr, zeros_ptr, scales_ptr, M, N, K,
                    group_size, BLOCK_SIZE_M: tl.constexpr,
                    BLOCK_SIZE_N: tl.constexpr, BLOCK_SIZE_K: tl.constexpr,
                    SPLIT_K: tl.constexpr):
    pid = tl.program_id(axis=0)
    pid_z = tl.program_id(axis=1)

    num_pid_n = tl.cdiv(N, BLOCK_SIZE_N)
    pid_m = pid // num_pid_n
    pid_n = pid % num_pid_n

    accumulator_dtype = c_ptr.type.element_ty
    accumulator = tl.zeros((BLOCK_SIZE_M, BLOCK_SIZE_N),
                           dtype=accumulator_dtype)

    reverse_awq_order_tensor = ((tl.arange(0, 2) * 4)[None, :] +
                                tl.arange(0, 4)[:, None]).reshape(8)
    shifts = reverse_awq_order_tensor * 4
    shifts = tl.interleave(shifts[0:4], shifts[4:8])

    offs_am = pid_m * BLOCK_SIZE_M + tl.arange(0, BLOCK_SIZE_M)
    offs_bn_packed = pid_n * (BLOCK_SIZE_N // 8) + tl.arange(0, BLOCK_SIZE_N // 8)
    offs_bn = pid_n * BLOCK_SIZE_N + tl.arange(0, BLOCK_SIZE_N)

    mask_am = offs_am < M
    mask_bn_packed = offs_bn_packed < tl.cdiv(N, 8)
    mask_bn = offs_bn < N

    offs_k = pid_z * BLOCK_SIZE_K + tl.arange(0, BLOCK_SIZE_K)
    a_ptrs = a_ptr + K * offs_am[:, None] + offs_k[None, :]
    b_ptrs = b_ptr + (N // 8) * offs_k[:, None] + offs_bn_packed[None, :]

    for k in range(0, tl.cdiv(K, BLOCK_SIZE_K * SPLIT_K)):
        mask_k = offs_k < K
        a = tl.load(a_ptrs, mask=mask_am[:, None] & mask_k[None, :], other=0)

        b_packed = tl.load(b_ptrs,
                           mask=mask_k[:, None] & mask_bn_packed[None, :],
                           other=0)
        b = tl.broadcast_to(b_packed[:, :, None],
                            (BLOCK_SIZE_K, BLOCK_SIZE_N // 8, 8))
        b = ((b >> shifts[None, None, :]) & 0xF)
        b = tl.reshape(b, (BLOCK_SIZE_K, BLOCK_SIZE_N))

        group_idx = offs_k // group_size
        group_mask = group_idx < tl.cdiv(K, group_size)

        zeros_offsets = (N // 8) * group_idx[:, None] + offs_bn_packed[None, :]
        zeros_packed = tl.load(zeros_ptr + zeros_offsets,
                               mask=group_mask[:, None] & mask_bn_packed[None, :],
                               other=0)
        zeros = tl.broadcast_to(zeros_packed[:, :, None],
                                (BLOCK_SIZE_K, BLOCK_SIZE_N // 8, 8))
        zeros = ((zeros >> shifts[None, None, :]) & 0xF)
        zeros = tl.reshape(zeros, (BLOCK_SIZE_K, BLOCK_SIZE_N))

        scale_offsets = N * group_idx[:, None] + offs_bn[None, :]
        scales = tl.load(scales_ptr + scale_offsets,
                         mask=group_mask[:, None] & mask_bn[None, :],
                         other=0)
        scales = tl.broadcast_to(scales, (BLOCK_SIZE_K, BLOCK_SIZE_N))

        b = (b - zeros) * scales
        b = b.to(c_ptr.type.element_ty)

        accumulator = tl.dot(a, b, accumulator, out_dtype=accumulator_dtype)

        offs_k += BLOCK_SIZE_K * SPLIT_K
        a_ptrs += BLOCK_SIZE_K * SPLIT_K
        b_ptrs += BLOCK_SIZE_K * SPLIT_K * (N // 8)

    c = accumulator.to(c_ptr.type.element_ty)
    offs_cm = pid_m * BLOCK_SIZE_M + tl.arange(0, BLOCK_SIZE_M)
    offs_cn = pid_n * BLOCK_SIZE_N + tl.arange(0, BLOCK_SIZE_N)
    c_ptrs = c_ptr + N * offs_cm[:, None] + offs_cn[None, :]
    c_mask = (offs_cm[:, None] < M) & (offs_cn[None, :] < N)
    if SPLIT_K == 1:
        tl.store(c_ptrs, c, mask=c_mask)
    else:
        tl.atomic_add(c_ptrs, c, mask=c_mask)
vllm/model_executor/layers/quantization/.awq_dequantize_kernel:
@triton.jit
def awq_dequantize_kernel(
        qweight_ptr,  # quantized matrix
        scales_ptr,  # scales, per group
        zeros_ptr,  # zeros, per group
        group_size,  # Should always be one of the supported group sizes
        result_ptr,  # Output matrix
        num_cols,  # input num cols in qweight
        num_rows,  # input num rows in qweight
        BLOCK_SIZE_X: tl.constexpr,
        BLOCK_SIZE_Y: tl.constexpr):
    pid_x = tl.program_id(axis=0)
    pid_y = tl.program_id(axis=1)

    offs_y = pid_y * BLOCK_SIZE_Y + tl.arange(0, BLOCK_SIZE_Y)
    offs_x_packed = pid_x * BLOCK_SIZE_X + tl.arange(0, BLOCK_SIZE_X)
    offs_x_unpacked = pid_x * BLOCK_SIZE_X * 8 + tl.arange(0, BLOCK_SIZE_X * 8)

    mask_y = offs_y < num_rows
    mask_x_packed = offs_x_packed < num_cols
    mask_x_unpacked = offs_x_unpacked < num_cols * 8

    q_offsets = num_cols * offs_y[:, None] + offs_x_packed[None, :]
    q_mask = mask_y[:, None] & mask_x_packed[None, :]
    qweight = tl.load(qweight_ptr + q_offsets, mask=q_mask, other=0)

    reverse_awq_order_tensor = ((tl.arange(0, 2) * 4)[None, :] +
                                tl.arange(0, 4)[:, None]).reshape(8)
    shifts = reverse_awq_order_tensor * 4
    shifts = tl.interleave(shifts[0:4], shifts[4:8])

    qweight = tl.broadcast_to(qweight[:, :, None],
                              (BLOCK_SIZE_Y, BLOCK_SIZE_X, 8))
    qweight = ((qweight >> shifts[None, None, :]) & 0xF)
    qweight = tl.reshape(qweight, (BLOCK_SIZE_Y, BLOCK_SIZE_X * 8))

    group_idx = offs_y // group_size
    group_mask = group_idx < tl.cdiv(num_rows, group_size)

    z_offsets = num_cols * group_idx[:, None] + offs_x_packed[None, :]
    z_mask = group_mask[:, None] & mask_x_packed[None, :]
    zeros = tl.load(zeros_ptr + z_offsets, mask=z_mask, other=0)
    zeros = tl.broadcast_to(zeros[:, :, None], (BLOCK_SIZE_Y, BLOCK_SIZE_X, 8))
    zeros = ((zeros >> shifts[None, None, :]) & 0xF)
    zeros = tl.reshape(zeros, (BLOCK_SIZE_Y, BLOCK_SIZE_X * 8))

    s_offsets = (num_cols * 8) * group_idx[:, None] + offs_x_unpacked[None, :]
    s_mask = group_mask[:, None] & mask_x_unpacked[None, :]
    scales = tl.load(scales_ptr + s_offsets, mask=s_mask, other=0)

    result = (qweight - zeros) * scales
    result = result.to(result_ptr.type.element_ty)

    result_offsets = (num_cols * 8) * offs_y[:, None] + offs_x_unpacked[None, :]
    result_mask = mask_y[:, None] & mask_x_unpacked[None, :]
    tl.store(result_ptr + result_offsets, result, mask=result_mask)
